name: Dreg Husk
seed: Organizes stolen freight and distributes shares. Wants predictable returns; resents Brakka wasting food on prestige.
design: Male boar, bristled charcoal head, short natural tusks, ochre freight vest, heavy blue belt pouches.
history: Millmere hauler who followed freight work west and then joined Brakka for reliable shares.
desire: To feed his crew and support relatives in the legitimate Cinder Cuts neighborhood.
contradiction: Treats organized theft as honest work because it has schedules.
relationships: Brakka frustrates him; Bale buys indirectly; Vessa knows his family route.
arc: Refuses to burn captured supplies for intimidation, triggering a split. Restitution to victims is the test of change.
story_engine: A stolen crate contains something useless to raiders but vital to a village; his family refuses money they know came from theft.
writer_truth: He has quietly kept records of victims, initially as a bargaining asset rather than conscience.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
